title: Passage 44
voice: 温暖自然英式女老师｜IndexTTS2.5 慢速教学

sentences.en: Wetlands are any land that is flooded with shallow water all or most of the time.
sentences.cn: 湿地是指所有时间或大部分时间都被浅水淹没的土地。

sentences.en: They are a natural water holding system.
sentences.cn: 它们是天然的蓄水系统。

sentences.en: Many animals come to wetlands to drink water when they are thirsty.
sentences.cn: 许多动物口渴时都会到湿地喝水。

sentences.en: There are many types of wetlands.
sentences.cn: 湿地有很多种。

sentences.en: Among them, bogs, marshes and swamps are the three main types.
sentences.cn: 其中，泥沼、草本沼泽和沼泽是三种主要类型。

sentences.en: In bogs, only mosses and a few other kinds of plants can grow.
sentences.cn: 在泥沼中，只有苔藓和少数其他种类的植物能够生长。

sentences.en: Grassy plants like cattails and reeds are the most common plants in a marsh.
sentences.cn: 在草本沼泽中，最常见的植物是香蒲和芦苇等草类植物。

sentences.en: A swamp is a forest whose ground is underwater all or most of the time.
sentences.cn: 沼泽是一片其地面永久或大部分时间都处于水下的森林。

sentences.en: Unlike bogs or marshes, a swamp is full of trees and bushes, with some trees standing tall as a tower.
sentences.cn: 与泥沼或草本沼泽不同，沼泽里满是树木和灌木，有些树木就像塔一样高。

sentences.en: A special kind of rose also grows here.
sentences.cn: 一种特殊的玫瑰也生长在这里。

sentences.en: The swamp is worth a short tour, but you'd better not try without a guide.
sentences.cn: 来一次短途旅行去看看沼泽是值得的，但如果没有导游的话，最好就不要尝试了。

sentences.en: There are hidden pools of water, thick mud, and sometimes big crocodiles looking for their next meal.
sentences.cn: 这里有隐藏的水潭、厚厚的淤泥，有时还有正在寻找下一顿美餐的大鳄鱼。

sentences.en: Hungry crocodiles aren't the only animals that make the wetlands their home.
sentences.cn: 饥饿的鳄鱼并不是唯一以湿地为家的动物。

sentences.en: Otters, turtles, frogs, snakes and many other animals do too.
sentences.cn: 水獭、乌龟、青蛙、蛇和许多其他动物也栖息于此。

sentences.en: The water is home to many kinds of fish and crabs.
sentences.cn: 水中生活着各种各样的鱼和蟹。

sentences.en: Birds, including ducks, geese and cranes, use wetlands seasonally during their long migrations.
sentences.cn: 鸭子、鹅、鹤等鸟类在漫长的迁徙途中会季节性地利用湿地。

sentences.en: Wetlands are important because they provide habitats for plants and animals.
sentences.cn: 湿地很重要，因为它们为动植物提供了栖息地。

sentences.en: A wetland system can also protect shorelines, make polluted waters clean, prevent floods and restore underground water supplies.
sentences.cn: 湿地系统还可以保护海岸线，净化被污染的水域，防洪以及恢复地下水供应。

sentences.en: It is important to let the wetlands perform their usual functions.
sentences.cn: 让湿地发挥惯常的作用至关重要。

sentences.en: Therefore, many voluntary groups work to protect wetlands by providing different services,
sentences.cn: 因此，许多志愿团体通过提供不同的服务，如清洁活动和公众教育，来保护湿地。

sentences.en: such as clean-up events and educating the public.
sentences.cn: 因此，许多志愿团体通过提供不同的服务，如清洁活动和公众教育，来保护湿地。
